summary.text: Scott Hege is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Democrat Hank Sanders.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Wasco County Commissioner, engineer and small business leader.

paragraphs.text: Hege graduated from Joel E. Ferris High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Idaho in 1984 and a graduate degree from Washington State University in 1986, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as engineer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Wasco County since 1991, previously served as executive director of the Port of The Dalles, has served 16 years as a county commissioner, and now chairs the county board and is principal of S3B Group in the construction sector.
He listed cost of living, economic development and small business, and education as his key campaign messages.
